# Panel

A light, translucent container that gives related information structure.

## Basic usage

<DemoPreview name="panel" />

## API

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | string | undefined | Supporting text under the title; a custom header slot replaces it |
| `title` | string | undefined | Panel title |

### Slots

- default: content
- header: custom title and description
- actions: header actions, also available without a title
- footer: bottom action area

## Keyboard and usage notes

The panel does not take focus itself; its content follows the natural document order.

## Installation

```ts
import { AgmPanel } from 'augma'
import 'augma/style.css'
```

Copy the editable source:

```sh
pnpm dlx shadcn-vue@2.8.2 add https://augma.yyj.moe/r/panel.json
```
